channel.title: Torah Scholar AI — Planet Leads Academy
channel.description: This course studies Jewish tradition and texts as they are understood within Jewish scholarship and practice. Beliefs are presented as what Jewish scholars and tradition hold, not as claims made by this course on behalf of all readers. Where a passage is paraphrased, it is labelled as a paraphrase. Verbatim quotations are given only where the wording is certain, with book, chapter, and verse. No new words are presented as Scripture. No sectarian position is presented as the only Jewish position, and differences between movements and scholars are noted where they matter.
channel.itunes:author: Ramel Hyman
